Create study population arguments

Source: R/StudyPopulation.R
createStudyPopulationArgs.Rd

Specifies the outcome and inclusion/exclusion criteria for [createStudyPopulation()].

Usage

createStudyPopulationArgs(
  outcomeId,
  firstExposureOnly = FALSE,
  washoutPeriod = 0L,
  removeDuplicateSubjects = "keep all",
  priorOutcomeLookback = 0L,
  requireTimeAtRisk = TRUE,
  minDaysAtRisk = 1L,
  maxDaysAtRisk = 99999L,
  riskWindowStart = 0L,
  riskWindowEnd = 0L,
  startAnchor = "cohort start",
  endAnchor = "cohort end",
  censorAtNewRiskWindow = FALSE
)

Arguments

outcomeId

(`integer(1)`) Cohort ID of the outcome of interest.

firstExposureOnly

(`logical(1)`) If `TRUE`, keep only the earliest cohort entry per person per treatment arm. Default: `FALSE`.

washoutPeriod

(`integer(1)`) Minimum days of prior observation required. Applied only when the `cohorts` table includes `observation_period_start_date`; silently skipped otherwise. Default: `0`.

removeDuplicateSubjects

(`character(1)`) How to handle persons who appear in both the switcher and comparator arms: `"keep all"` (default), `"keep first"` (one row per person, earliest index date), or `"remove all"` (exclude all such persons).

priorOutcomeLookback

(`integer(1)`) Exclude persons who had the outcome within this many days before their index date. `0` means no exclusion. Default: `0`.

requireTimeAtRisk

(`logical(1)`) If `TRUE`, exclude persons who have fewer than `minDaysAtRisk` days in their risk window. Default: `TRUE`.

minDaysAtRisk

(`integer(1)`) Minimum days at risk required when `requireTimeAtRisk` is `TRUE`. Default: `1`.

maxDaysAtRisk

(`integer(1)`) Cap the follow-up at this many days. Outcomes occurring after the cap are not counted. `99999` means no cap. Default: `99999`.

riskWindowStart

(`integer(1)`) Days from `startAnchor` to the start of the risk window. Default: `0`.

riskWindowEnd

(`integer(1)`) Days from `endAnchor` to the end of the risk window. Default: `0`.

startAnchor

(`character(1)`) The date to which `riskWindowStart` is added: `"cohort start"` (index date) or `"cohort end"`. Default: `"cohort start"`.

endAnchor

(`character(1)`) The date to which `riskWindowEnd` is added: `"cohort start"` (index date) or `"cohort end"`. Default: `"cohort end"`.

censorAtNewRiskWindow

(`logical(1)`) Reserved for future use. Default: `FALSE`.

Value

A `StudyPopulationArgs` R6 object.

References

Suissa S, Moodie EE, Dell'Aniello S. Prevalent new-user cohort designs for comparative drug effect studies by time-conditional propensity scores. *Pharmacoepidemiol Drug Saf* 2017;26(4):459-468. doi:10.1002/pds.4117

Examples

args <- createStudyPopulationArgs(
  outcomeId = 3L,
  requireTimeAtRisk = TRUE,
  minDaysAtRisk = 1L,
  riskWindowStart = 0L,
  riskWindowEnd = 365L,
  endAnchor = "cohort start"
)
